financial_question: Does the CSI1000 opening-gap pass-through from the already-validated pre-auction SGX A50 offshore-China price-discovery signal vary continuously with the magnitude of the offshore shock, even when the direction of the shock is held fixed?
why_this_is_not_a_new_information_source: This phase does not add another market. It tests whether the linear Ridge mapping used by v6 underfits the transmission function of the strongest validated information source.

economic_prior.hypothesis: Cross-market spillovers can be nonlinear/asymmetric, with transmission intensity changing in extreme or turbulent states. A parsimonious signed-magnitude term can test this without introducing a threshold, regime count, hidden state, or model-family search.

evidence.title: Time-varying spillover between the mainland China stock market and the other global main stock markets base on the non-linear Granger causality test
evidence.relevance: Reports nonlinear spillovers between mainland China and major global stock markets.

evidence.title: Asymmetric spillover effects between the Shanghai and Hong Kong stock markets: evidence from quantile lagged regression
evidence.relevance: Finds return spillovers depend on market state and differ across the conditional distribution.

evidence.title: Regime-dependent volatility spillover asymmetry in Shanghai and Hong Kong stock markets with forecasting and portfolio inferences
evidence.relevance: Shows spillover asymmetry intensifies in high-volatility regimes; supports non-constant transmission but not any specific nonlinear formula.

mathematical_choice.interpretation: The linear A50 main effect remains in the model. The additional odd quadratic term lets the marginal pass-through slope change smoothly with absolute shock magnitude while preserving the sign of the transformed shock itself.

why_not_more_flexible_methods.HMM_or_Markov_switching: Rejected for this first nonlinearity test because state count, transition structure and estimation choices add large multiplicity after the v8 state-interaction failure.
why_not_more_flexible_methods.splines_or_GAM: Deferred because knot number/location or smoothing penalties would add tuning freedom on a consumed holdout.
why_not_more_flexible_methods.piecewise_thresholds: Rejected because threshold selection would directly turn 2019-2020 into a tuning set.
why_not_more_flexible_methods.positive_negative_separate_terms: Deferred; direction asymmetry is a distinct hypothesis and would add another selectable degree of freedom.

causal_scope.ordinary_rows: same frozen v6 ordinary A50 source and target cutoff strictly before 09:15
causal_scope.holiday_rows: new nonlinear term is exactly 0; holiday mechanism remains the frozen v5 A50 closure channel

economic_coherence_gate.reason: The new basis may bend the response curve but must not imply that an incremental rise in A50 predicts a lower CSI1000 opening gap anywhere in the observed training ordinary-session support. This prevents a numerically attractive but economically perverse sign reversal.
